title: Clarification on `unicode-bidi` for `input type text` and `ruby`

labels.name: i18n-tracker
labels.description: Group bringing to attention of Internationalization, or tracked by i18n but not needing response.

body:
### What is the issue with the HTML Standard?

Hi All,

While trying to implement and understand specification, I have two queries to clarify:

1. As per following [1], the specification says following:

_"Bidi isolation is forced on all [internal ruby boxes](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-ruby/#internal-ruby-boxes) and the [ruby container](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-ruby/#ruby-container): the [normal](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-writing-modes-4/#valdef-unicode-bidi-normal) and [embed](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-writing-modes-4/#valdef-unicode-bidi-embed) values of [unicode-bidi](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-writing-modes-3/#propdef-unicode-bidi) compute to [isolate](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-writing-modes-4/#valdef-unicode-bidi-isolate), and [bidi-override](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-writing-modes-4/#valdef-unicode-bidi-bidi-override) computes to [isolate-override](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-writing-modes-4/#valdef-unicode-bidi-isolate-override)."_

[1] https://drafts.csswg.org/css-ruby/#bidi , https://drafts.csswg.org/css-ruby/#default-ua-ruby

Which interprets that even if you have `unicode-bidi: embed`, it should be `isolate` and even mentioned in UA rules.

While WPT test seems to test different - http://wpt.live/html/rendering/bidi-rendering/unicode-bidi-ua-rules.html, where it is expecting `normal` should return `normal`.

Q: Appreciate if someone can clarify this or whether we need to update WPT test to reflect the CSS Ruby specification.

2. Similarly, for `input types`, the web specification [2] is limited to few input types:

[2] https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/rendering.html#bidi-rendering

```
input[dir=auto i]:is([type=search i], [type=tel i], [type=url i],
[type=email i]) {
  unicode-bidi: plaintext;
}
```

and just below, it states following:

_When an [input](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/input.html#the-input-element) element's [dir](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dom.html#attr-dir) attribute is in the [auto](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dom.html#attr-dir-auto) state and its [type](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/input.html#attr-input-type) attribute is in the [Text](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/input.html#text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search)) state, then the user agent is expected to act as if it had a user-agent-level style sheet rule setting the ['unicode-bidi'](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-writing-modes/#unicode-bidi) property to 'plaintext'._

While doing following PR in WebKit - https://github.com/WebKit/WebKit/pull/38434, it was mentioned that we should clarify whether this should be extended to other text input types such as `password` and `text` itself.

Appreciate if we can clarify and whether we need to extend our test coverage as well.

Thanks!

@fantasai and @pxlcoder - FYI
